  
	  
**FOUNDERS CIRCLE MOCK UP FEEDBACK** 

**Summary:** With the most recent shift in the direction of the Signature Journey length, itinerary, and extension packages and the focus of group trips. I’m recommending the following changes to help ensure the Founder’s Circle page is aligned with these most recent changes: 

Mock up Version  
**![][image1]**  
Current Version  
**![][image2]**

 **(TOP) Header Menu:** Please note that the **top header** that is featured in the mock up shouldn’t appear on our current FC page until all pages have been built. The feedback that follows is assuming that all pages have been built.   
Currently, it’s not clear what For Groups, even means as part of the current menu bar. I’d incorporate that under a wider section called Ways to Travel and include it as an option in the drop down and change it to “Group Trips” or a name more fitting

- Signature Journey   
- Experiences  
- Ways to Travel \-  Group Trips, TBD other options  
- About Us   
- Contact  
- Reserve Your Place

(Table of Contents) From Current Version: We should keep the current table of contents bar that appears below the hero on the FC page currently as this allows for easy navigation. 

**Hero:** While the format itself is nice, it’s best practice for a hero to provide 1 singular call-to-action. Our priority isn't having folks watch a film (because clicking that link would direct them off the page). Instead our goal is to have folks sign up to be a part of the founder’s circle and essentially sign up to plan their next trip with us. We want them to stay on the current page to learn more.   
**Recommendation:** We should keep the “Reserve Your Space” button which will direct folks to the form section on the page.

History & Culture   
Johannesburg & Soweto

A warm welcome from **Lucia Motloung**, a CEO of black-owned wine company Luc Mo Wines, ride through the colorful streets of Soweto, where history and culture come to light before your eyes. Have lunch with **Antoinette Sithole,** sister of  the late Hector Pieterson whose legacy in the anti-apartheid movement lives on.

Safari Game Drives  
The Sabi Sand

There are few places on earth where you can watch lions, leopards, elephants, buffalo, and rhinos move freely through the wild. Days in the Sabi Sand follow the rhythm of the bush: early morning game drives as the light breaks, and golden-hour sundowners as the day slows down. 

The Cape  
Cape Town

Experience the city where mountain meets ocean: Robben Island with **Christo Brand**, the warder who once guarded Mandela, and a day on the Black-owned Winelands route with **Ntsiki Biyela**, the first Black woman winemaker in South Africa

A World Wonder  
Victoria Falls

The journey extends north to Victoria Falls, one of the world's seven natural wonders straddling the border of Zambia and Zimbabwe. Feel the mist, hear the thunder, and experience the majesty of these incredible falls up-close. Enjoy dinner over the Zambezi river and be in awe as you dine over the fourth-largest river in Africa. 

Discover Africa’s Eden  
Chobe National Park, Botswana

Cross into Botswana and experience wilderness like never before. Drift down the Chobe River at golden hour on a boat cruise as elephants gather on the banks in numbers found almost nowhere else on earth. A rare ending that outdoes everything before it.

## A new company, built on *long relationships*.

It is built on people we know by name.

Umoya is African-led and African-owned, and of the diaspora ourselves. Wilson Nyah built it over a decade of work across the continent, and on the relationships that came with it. Those relationships are why Lucia Motloung pours her own wine on your first evening, and why Antoinette Sithole sits at your table in Soweto and tells you about the day in 1976 she lived herself.

Around those moments, the work is ours. You are met at the airport, a host stays with you the whole way, and what would normally be yours to organise is carried for you. You arrive as a guest of people who are glad to share their home.

Plan with absolute confidence

**Guaranteed departures**

\+

Once your departure is confirmed, it is guaranteed. From that point you can book flights and make arrangements knowing your journey will proceed as planned.

Your journey, your way

**Thoughtful personalization**

\+

Each itinerary is carefully designed, and yours can flex to your interests. Optional experiences let you add private tastings, extended time at a site, or access to a particular host.

Peace of mind for your investment

**Travel protection**

\+

We strongly recommend travel insurance at the time of booking. Your travel expert can guide you to reputable providers so you can focus on the journey, not the logistics.

Paced for depth

**Signature Journey structure**

\+

The Signature Journey runs ten days across three movements, Heritage, Safari, and the Cape, with optional extensions to Victoria Falls and Chobe. This pacing is what gives the journey its depth.

Flavours that meet your needs

**Regional cuisine & dietary care**

\+

You taste regional cuisine prepared by local hosts and chefs throughout. Dietary needs are collected in advance and handled with care, because your wellbeing is part of the journey.
